repos_data.description: Local Deep Research achieves ~95% on SimpleQA benchmark (tested with GPT-4.1-mini). Supports local and cloud LLMs (Ollama, Google, Anthropic, ...). Searches 10+ sources - arXiv, PubMed, web, and your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.
MCP search and evidence tool for AI agents with query rewriting, source zoom-in, sourced answers, and runtime metrics.
